browser.tabs.doc: Open tabs, a bot's or the user's.

browser.open.doc: Opens a tab in its owner's partition, headless unless `show` names a view.

browser.close.doc: Closes a tab, whoever opened it.

browser.navigate.doc: Loads a URL in a tab.

browser.show.doc: Moves a tab into a browser view without reloading; it lays out at the view's size.

browser.hide.doc: Moves a tab back to headless, at the agent's 1280×800.

browser.hold.doc: The user takes or gives back a tab in the view; an agent's commands on it are refused while held.

browser.screenshot.doc: A picture of a tab, taken without showing it.

browser.cdp.doc: One DevTools call on a tab's own debugger, if its domain is allowed.

browser.stream.doc: Streams a tab to another device as video on a link stream of its own (S7 edit 3).

app.tab.open.doc: Opens a `WebContentsView` in the owner's partition.

app.tab.command.doc: One command on a tab in the app.

app.tab.list.doc: The app's tabs, after either side restarted.

browser.report.doc: The app reports what happened to its tabs; DevTools events only for subscribed, allowlisted methods.

tab_changed.doc: A tab opened, loaded, moved or was taken by the user.

tab_closed.doc: A tab closed, by its owner, the page or a crash.

cdp_event.doc: An allowlisted DevTools event from a tab the plugin follows.
